researcher_notes: Opus full-redo pass. Single source document: 'Kivnon-Catalogo-2026-—-Editable-ENG.pdf' (23 pp, EN, Edition 2026), byte-identical duplicate 'Kivnon-Catalogo-2026-—-Editable-ENG-2.pdf' (md5 e5936bcb1bb6d83b199d3e448c921368) collapsed into one processing unit. The catalogue is a multi-product catalogue covering EIGHT models (K05, K07, K10, K11, K32, K50, K55, K60) plus company and technology sections. The DB currently holds TEN Kivnon products, so the mapping is not 1:1 in either direction — see 'coverage_mismatches' below. Several DB models (K10P, K41, K55A naming) are NOT in the 2026 catalogue, and several catalogue sub-configurations (K07-SQ600/SQ1500, K50-S2002/S3002, K55B, K60-S1516/S1530) have no DB row. Variant completion proposed accordingly. Nothing here has been written to Airtable.
